top_choice_rationale: P001 credits Drucker, Holst and Knudsen for GLP-1 physiology and its development into long-acting incretin therapies. The science is mature and independently confirmed, with randomized outcome data in glycaemia, weight and cardiovascular and renal disease. The citation names both the physiology and the analogues that turned it into medicines, and each name rests on a documented contribution. The Mojsov and Habener priority record cannot be verified from the allowed material, so P002 is a close second. It is a defensible discovery-centred trio but leaves the clinical half uncredited. No award (P000) is last because the achievement is clearly prize-worthy.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented connection to the GLP-1 candidates, and shared KI affiliation with other members does not establish a conflict
